source.title: DOE Announces Science Applications for Quantum Computing
source.source_scope: Announcement says eight applications across four domains but does not enumerate the complete application-level specifications in the article body.

scope_warning: This is a contract template for four source-listed domains, not a complete list of the eight QGPAs. Do not infer missing application names or benchmark targets.

domains.name: Chemistry
domains.source_scope: Reaction mechanisms and dynamics in complicated chemical systems, including light-sensitive processes.

domains.name: Materials
domains.source_scope: Ground states and dynamics of quantum materials and materials in extreme environments, including topological or superconducting systems.

domains.name: Subatomic physics
domains.source_scope: Interactions underlying protons and neutrons, nuclear structure, and matter at high density such as fusion reactions.

domains.name: Applied mathematics
domains.source_scope: Systems of linear and differential equations used across scientific disciplines.

provider_neutrality.rule: Provider inclusion is a compatibility target, not a statement that credentials, access, price, or a specific workload is available.

cross_cutting.rule: Program announcements and external workflow tools cannot be promoted to UQPU experimental or commercial evidence.

next_gate: Obtain the complete official QGPA specifications; map each named application to an accepted-output contract and reference baseline; then select one bounded workload for exact/simulator validation.
